description: This file defines a custom Gson TypeAdapter for serializing and deserializing java.time.LocalDate objects to and from JSON in ISO_LOCAL_DATE format.

classes.name: LocalDateAdapter
classes.description: A Gson TypeAdapter for LocalDate to handle JSON serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes a LocalDate object into JSON as an ISO formatted date string.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON date string into a LocalDate object.
